items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Well, he and I had been friends over the years.

ctx.x: On trumpet, yes, in the Basie band. When the Basie band was developed, after they were well known. But Emmett could read more than anybody would give him credit for, along with being a swinging trumpet player -- and a charming, beautiful, wonderful man.
